card.name: Digits inside dose numbers
card.fires_on: Single digits (often 1 or 5) or a decimal point partway through a numeric dose or table value, and sometimes an 'and' in a list of doses or time points. It is seen in dosing instructions and result tables.

modes.label: Digit inside a number
modes.description: A digit or decimal point in the middle of a multi-digit dose or ratio.

modes.label: And in a list
modes.description: The word 'and' joining the last item in a list of doses or time points.

card.writes: It seems to push toward number-continuation tokens such as year counts, though the effect is unclear.
card.plain: It fires on the middle of a dose number as the label is still spelling out the amount.
